lesson_title: Piaget in Education: Conservation and Egocentrism

items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to egocentrism, conservation, McGarrigle and Donaldson's Naughty Teddy study, and Hughes's Policeman Doll study.

items.title: The Life Scientific — BBC Radio 4
items.description: Jim Al-Khalili interviews leading scientists; episodes on child development and cognitive science relate to evaluating Piaget's educational claims.

items.title: The Growth of Knowledge: Crash Course Psychology #18
items.description: Covers Piaget's conservation task and egocentrism, providing the theoretical background for the McGarrigle and Hughes challenges.

items.title: Monkeys and Morality: Crash Course Psychology #19
items.description: Explores how researchers test what children can and cannot understand — relevant to evaluating Piaget's methodology.

items.title: Three Identical Strangers
items.description: Illustrates the debate over how early experiences and environment shape cognition — a real-world lens on the nature vs nurture questions raised by Piaget's critics.

items.title: AQA GCSE Psychology 8182 — Specification
items.description: Lists the specific studies (McGarrigle and Donaldson; Hughes) and concepts (conservation, egocentrism) that AQA requires for this unit.

items.title: SaveMyExams — AQA GCSE Psychology
items.description: Practice exam questions on conservation and egocentrism, including evaluation of Piaget's educational implications.
